blocks.text: Filipino Comedian Gil Aducal Morales, popularly known as Ate Gay, has passed away on November 1, 2026, his family announced. He was 55. READ: Ate Gay placed on life support after septic shock, stroke Morales’ family released the sad news two days after stating the comedian was in critical condition and relying on life support after suffering septic shock, acute respiratory failure secondary to pneumonia, and stroke. “It is with profound sadness and heavy hearts that our family announces the passing of our beloved Gil Aducal Morales, lovingly known to many as Ate Gay, on November 1, 2026,” the family said […]...
